title: 新加坡模式能否复制 全球保护主义升温下的开放路径
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: China's economic rise is one of the great transformation stories of the modern era.
segments.zh: 中国的经济崛起是现代最重大的转型故事之一。

segments.en: In just a few decades, it left it hundreds of millions out of poverty and built an economy that now rival the United States and Europe
segments.zh: 短短几十年间，数亿人摆脱贫困，建立起如今可与美欧比肩的经济体，

segments.en: with world-class infrastructure, manufacturing capacity, and talent.
segments.zh: 拥有世界级的基础设施、制造能力和人才。

segments.en: But China's rise didn't happen in a vacuum.
segments.zh: 但中国的崛起并非孤立发生。

segments.en: In the late 1970s, as Deng Xiaoping set out to modernize China, he looked abroad for ideas. One place stood out Singapore.
segments.zh: 上世纪70年代末，邓小平着手推动中国现代化时，曾向海外寻找思路。有一个地方格外突出：新加坡。

segments.en: And China wasn't the only country taking notes. Over the decades, governments from India to Brazil have looked to Singapore for lessons on
segments.zh: 而中国并非唯一取经者。几十年来，从印度到巴西，多国政府都曾向新加坡学习

segments.en: growth and governance with varying degrees of success.
segments.zh: 增长与治理之道，成效各有不同。

segments.en: But the world that helped create the Singapore model is changing.
segments.zh: 但当初催生新加坡模式的世界，正在改变。

segments.en: Indeed, if Singapore were to start today, I am not sure the Singapore model will work.
segments.zh: 事实上，如果新加坡今天才起步，我不确定新加坡模式还能奏效。

segments.en: Because the world is getting more protectionist, globalization is not there anymore.
segments.zh: 因为世界正变得更加保护主义，全球化已不复当年。

segments.en: Ambassador Chan-Hing Chi is one of Singapore's most respected strategic minds.
segments.zh: 陈庆珠大使是新加坡最受尊敬的战略思想家之一。

segments.en: She joins us in this episode, along with Push and Dot, professor of economics and political science. It's in Seattle.
segments.zh: 她与经济学和政治学教授普什和多特一同做客本期节目。地点在西雅图。
